title: glioma-survival-benchmark: transparent versus neural-network models for overall-survival prediction in public glioma data
description: Analysis code for a benchmark of transparent regression, standard machine-learning and TensorFlow neural-network models for fixed-horizon overall-survival prediction in adult diffuse glioma, developed in TCGA and externally validated in Gravendeel and REMBRANDT. Includes harmonisation of the public GlioVis data objects, repeated cross-validation, external validation, calibration and decision-curve analysis, time-to-event models and sensitivity analyses.
